plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Gather & Chill
plugins.Punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.Description: A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.
plugins.Changelog:
- Added a button to import/add your list from teamcraft
- Fixed hidden items getting stuck in a loop if you didn't have the gp for the action
- Gathering log page now has a progress bar to show you how close you are to completing it

plugins.Name: Chilled Leves
plugins.Punchline: I heard you like your leves on the rocks.
plugins.Description: The leve plugin that nobody wanted to make. Will display what leves you need to complete, as well as help automate them for your heart desires (not required though)
plugins.Changelog:
- Updated some outdated ui decisions (naming scheme's not matching... due to how long this took to rework and *-might-* of forgotten to change some buttons WOOOPS)
- Re-added the safety throttle to npc interactions (I think I covered them all? That way ya'll can seem "normal")
- Brought over the pandora handler to make sure that we don't interfier with it/don't end up causing a crash by accident (it'll re-enable itself don't worry)
- Adjusted Tuli's interact point for all 3 turnin npcs (yes... all 3 >.>) to be the same. So now you can be EVEN MORE SUS and stand in the exact spot where you can reach them all

plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugins.Punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON
plugins.Description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugins.Changelog: - Cosmic will only enable autohook if it needs to start a fishing mission, will not try and disable it.
